notes.title: Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer is NOW ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
Bimbos, bondage, superheroines becoming super sluts (and LOVING it!) Our new duo comes to the scene with fifteen (15) achievements and hours of erotic fun! Be sure to stop the mysterious Project Mesmer at all costs, or else the bad guys will change your mind.

The super fighting nun, Sister Fister, and her partner, the snarky and sarcastic Copy Kat, bring a powerful overhaul to the previous Damsels game. Fight in exciting turn based battles with the improved Action Sequences system to keep things fresh and full of danger, while avoiding becoming bound and trapped in heroic Perils. Endure traps and battles as the enemies attempt to turn the heroines into bubbly Bimbos, which in turn change the flow of combat and even how the world itself will treat them!

If you're stuck, don't forget that there is always the Discord that you can pop into and ask questions. Who knows, there might be people who already have answers for you!

Thank you all for your love and support!!

notes.title: Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer coming to STEAM on March 10th!!!
notes.notes:
Hello Damsels of Vice fans and enthusiasts!

For those of you who loved the series and wanted to see more, and for those of you who gave a lot of helpful feedback to make the sequel a more enjoyable experience for everyone than it already was, I am proud to present the Steam release of [i]Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer[/i]:

[previewyoutube=NQvzo0EW_TU;full][/previewyoutube]

The store page has all the info you need, but here are some other things that make this next installment extra exciting:

Supersized 720p gives a lot more room for the action and a lot of room for extra details, allowing you to really appreciate the amazing artwork and CGs done by returning artist Zinovia_Star! Players from other websites are raving about how incredible the art is for this one, and I must say, I agree! Plenty of hot scenarios are given a very sexy life by her artwork.

Everything from the first game has been supercharged, including much more direct feedback with the "Action Sequences" system and a much expanded  "Power Up!" skill learning system. Not only will you be turned into bimbos during battle, doing so is not game over! In fact, it changes how some NPCs and events react to the heroines, and how they react to them.

With a game this exciting, you'd have to be a BIMBO to pass it up! ;) (Hehe, only teasing!)

[h1][b]Wishlist it TODAY and pick it up on MARCH 10th!!![/b][/h1]
